label: Funk
blurb: One chord, infinite groove. Everything serves The One: syncopated bass, scratchy stabs, and a pocket-locked kit.

progressions.name: One-Chord Vamp
progressions.feel: A single minor-seventh organism breathing forever. The harmony stands still so the rhythm can dance.

progressions.name: Corner Vamp
progressions.feel: Two velvet drifters trading places — just enough motion to turn the block around.

progressions.name: Dominant Strut
progressions.feel: Both chords wear dominant sevenths and neither resolves. Strut, don't walk.

contours.name: Pocket Lock
contours.flavor: Heavy on The One, a ghost push on the and-of-two, a fifth in the gap, then a slide back in.

contours.name: Scratch Stabs
contours.flavor: Three clipped offbeat hits — third, seventh, fifth — leaving the rest of the bar to the drummer.

drumPatterns.name: Pocket Kit
drumPatterns.blurb: Syncopated kicks, a backbeat snare with a ghost at the bar's tail, hats sixteenth-tight on every sub.

drumPatterns.name: Sixteenth Pocket
drumPatterns.blurb: A true sixteenth-note funk grid: kicks around The One, ghost-note snares in the cracks, hats on all sixteen.

grooves.name: Sixteenth Strut
grooves.blurb: 100 BPM, light swing, sixteenth grid. The drummer plays the cracks between the beats.

grooves.name: Classic Pocket
grooves.blurb: Eighth-grid funk at 104 — simmering, not boiling.

creatures.name: Pocket Weasel
creatures.flavor: Lives inside the kick drum's shadow. Hits The One like rent is due.

creatures.name: Stab Mantis
creatures.flavor: Strikes three times per bar, exactly where the groove leaves a gap, then freezes.

songs.name: One-Chord Cooker
songs.blurb: Two alternating vamps that never resolve — groove A simmers on one chord, groove B stirs in the iv.
